traits.desc_vi: Đòn Đánh và Kỹ Năng của tướng Xạ Thuật Sư có thể nảy bật. Mỗi lần nảy sẽ gây một phần sát thương của lần nảy bật trước đó.

traits.desc_en: Juggernauts gain Durability, increasing based on their missing Health.
Your team gains 1 Mana Regen. Prodigies gain more.
For each active trait (except uniques), your team gains bonus Health and Damage Amp.
traits.desc_vi: Với mỗi tộc/hệ đang kích hoạt (trừ những tộc/hệ độc nhất), đội của bạn nhận thêm Máu và Khuếch Đại Sát Thương.

traits.desc_en: Your team gains 100 Health. Frontmen gain more, which increases after the first time they cast.
While at least one Bodyguard is alive, your team gains 15 Armor and Magic Resist. Bodyguards gain more.

Mystical Instruments can appear in your shop. There is one of each rarity. 

For each one you have, your team gains 3% Ability Power. Malzahar gains double.

If he has dealt 60000 damage and you have all 5 instruments, Malzahar writes his masterpiece, unlocking Baron Nashor.

DA_KDA19_StarPower.desc_en: When you 2-star a K/DA champion, gain a free K/DA champion. Gain a Lillia and a Neeko.

DA_KDA19_RunningWild.desc_en: At Combat Start, your 2 strongest K/DA champions without 3 items get a temporary recommended item and 250 Health. Gain a Neeko and a Lillia.

DA_OneTwosThree.desc_vi: Nhận 2 tướng 1 vàng, 2 tướng 2 vàng và 1 tướng 3 vàng

DA_OneTwoFive.desc_en: Gain 1 random component, 2 gold, and 1 random 5-cost champion.
DA_OneTwoFive.desc_vi: Nhận 1 trang bị thành phần ngẫu nhiên, 2 vàng và 1 tướng 5 vàng ngẫu nhiên

DA_GoodForSomethingI.name_vi: Được Cái Này Mất Cái Kia I
DA_GoodForSomethingI.desc_en: Champions that aren't holding items have a 40% chance to drop 1 gold on death.

DA_DuoQueue.desc_en: Gain 2 random 5-cost champions and 2 copies of a random component.
DA_DuoQueue.desc_vi: Nhận 2 tướng 5 vàng ngẫu nhiên và 2 bản sao của một trang bị thành phần ngẫu nhiên.

DA_CaretakersAlly.desc_en: Gain a random 2-cost champion now. Gain the same one again every time you level up.

DA_BranchingOutPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Emblem and a Reforger.

DA_AllThatShimmers+.desc_en: Choose a gold-generating Artifact. Gain a Magnetic Remover and 4 gold.

DA_AllThatShimmers.desc_en: Choose a gold-generating Artifact. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

DA_Annie19_HeroAugment.name_en: Tibbers! I Can't See the Stage
DA_Annie19_HeroAugment.name_vi: Tibbers! I Can't See the Stage
DA_Annie19_HeroAugment.desc_en: Gain an Annie and unlock Tibbers. Your strongest Annie becomes a Magic Caster that leaps onto your strongest Tibbers at the start of combat.

DA_FighterFlight.desc_en: Your Fighters and Assassins move faster and gain 10% Attack Speed. These bonuses are doubled while below 50% Health.

DA_FighterFlightII.desc_en: Your Fighters and Assassins move faster and gain 18% Attack Speed. These bonuses are doubled while below 50% Health.

DA_Elise19_HeroAugment.desc_en: Gain an Elise. Your strongest Elise becomes a Magic Assassin with a bite that she recasts on low Health enemies on kill.

DA_Renegade19_HighRolling.desc_en: Renegade kills have a chance to drop loot, scaling with Critical Strike Chance. The value of the loot given can also critically strike, granting even more loot. Gain a Qiyana.

DA_ReunionShowI.desc_en: Gain 10g of champions that all share a trait.

DA_ReunionShowII.desc_en: Gain 16g of champions that all share a trait.

DA_CritQuintessencePlus.desc_en: Gain 14 gold. Your team gains 1% Critical Strike Chance.

DA_TankApprentice.desc_en: Gain a Giant's Belt. After 3 player combats, gain a Negatron Cloak.

DA_FighterApprentice.desc_en: Gain Sparring Gloves. After 3 player combats, gain a Chain Vest.

DA_MarksmanApprentice.desc_en: Gain a Recurve Bow. After 3 player combats, gain a B.F. Sword.

DA_CasterApprentice.desc_en: Gain a Tear Of The Goddess. After 3 player combats, gain a Needlessly Large Rod.

DA_CheatCode.desc_en: Now and at the start of each stage, get a new cheat code. The first time you perform that exact sequence of actions, gain a reward.
DA_CheatCode.desc_vi: Ngay bây giờ và khi bắt đầu mỗi vòng đấu, nhận được một mã gian lận mới. Lần đầu tiên bạn thực hiện chính xác chuỗi hành động đó, nhận một phần thưởng.

DA_Kennen19_HeroAugment.desc_en: Gain a Kennen. Your strongest Kennen becomes a Magic Assassin who permanently adds True Damage to his spell on kills.

DA_CheatCodeGold.desc_en: Now and at the start of each stage, get a new cheat code. The first time you perform that exact sequence of actions, gain a reward.
DA_CheatCodeGold.desc_vi: Ngay bây giờ và khi bắt đầu mỗi vòng đấu, nhận được một mã gian lận mới. Lần đầu tiên bạn thực hiện chính xác chuỗi hành động đó, nhận một phần thưởng.

DA_CheatCodePrismatic.desc_en: Now and at the start of each stage, get a new cheat code. The first time you perform that exact sequence of actions, gain a reward.
DA_CheatCodePrismatic.desc_vi: Ngay bây giờ và khi bắt đầu mỗi vòng đấu, nhận được một mã gian lận mới. Lần đầu tiên bạn thực hiện chính xác chuỗi hành động đó, nhận một phần thưởng.

DA_GoodFOURtune.desc_en: Open a shop of 2-star 4-cost champions. You can only buy 1. Gain 16 gold.

DA_FeelingLuckyPlus.desc_en: Gain 18 gold, then flip a coin. If heads, gain 6 more gold.

DA_Omelas.desc_en: Gain a Training Dummy with 50% Durability. While it lives, all damage your champions would take is redirected to the dummy.

DA_BundleOShroomsSilver.desc_en: Gain 6 mushrooms, which each grant either 1 reroll, 2 XP, or 3 Tactician Health.

DA_BundleOShroomsGold.desc_en: Gain 9 mushrooms, which each grant either 1 reroll, 2 XP, or 3 Tactician Health.

DA_Pentakill19_GatheringStorm.desc_en: Your Pentakill champions gain 10 Health permanently every time the Pentakill trait executes an enemy. Gain 3 Pentakill champions.

DA_Augment19_Heartsteel_BigSolo.desc_en: Your Heartsteel Biases gain 150% more of all active Heartsteel bonuses. Gain 3 Heartsteel champions.

DA_TheDrop.desc_en: After 12 seconds of combat, your team heals 20% max Health and enemies take 8% max Health true damage.

DA_TheDropGold.desc_en: After 12 seconds of combat, your team heals 30% max Health and enemies take 12% max Health true damage.

DA_ThreeStepsAhead.desc_en: The next 3 times you lose a player combat, gain a 5-cost champion and 2 components.

DA_CountingStars.desc_en: Gain 5 gold. Each time you 3-star a champion, gain 5 gold for each 3-star you have.

DA_ZZRotAugment.desc_en: Gain a Zz'Rot Portal, an item which summons a large Voidspawn.

DA_LevelUp.desc_en: When you buy XP, gain an additional 2. Gain 10 immediately.

DA_HedgeFund.desc_en: Gain 22 gold. Your max interest is increased to 10.

DA_WorththeWait.desc_en: Gain a random 1-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

DA_WorththeWaitII.desc_en: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

DA_PatientStudy.desc_en: After player combat, gain 2 XP if you won or 3 XP if you lost.

DA_BuriedTreasuresIII.desc_en: Gain a random item component now and at the start of the next 6 rounds.

DA_GlassCannon_Gold.desc_en: Allies that start combat in the back row begin combat at 80% Health but gain 25% Damage Amp.

DA_ItemGrabBag.desc_vi: Nhận 1 trang bị hoàn chỉnh ngẫu nhiên.

DA_CalledShot.desc_en: Set your win streak to +4. Gain 4 gold.

DA_GlassCannon_Silver.desc_en: Allies that start combat in the back row begin combat at 80% Health but gain 16% Damage Amp.

DA_HeroicGrabBag.desc_en: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain 6 gold.

DA_HeroicGrabBagPlus.desc_en: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain 8 gold.

DA_HeroicGrabBagPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain 14 gold.

DA_InvestmentStrategy.desc_en: Your champions gain 10 permanent max health per interest you earn. Your max interest is increased by 2. Gain 6 gold now.

DA_OneBuffTwoBuff.desc_en: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

DA_PortableForge.desc_en: Choose 1 of 4 Artifacts. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.
DA_PortableForge.desc_vi: Chọn 1 trong 4 Tạo Tác. Tạo Tác là những trang bị mạnh mẽ hơn với hiệu ứng đặc biệt.

DA_CalculatedLoss.desc_en: After losing your combat, gain 2 gold and a free Shop reroll.

DA_LatentForge.desc_en: After 8 player combats, gain an Artifact Anvil.

DA_IronAssets.desc_en: Gain a component anvil and 3 gold.

DA_InvestedPlus.desc_en: Gain 26 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).
DA_InvestedPlus.desc_vi: Nhận 26 vàng. Khi bắt đầu mỗi vòng đấu, nhận 1 lượt làm mới Cửa Hàng với mỗi 10 vàng vượt hơn 50 (tối đa 80 vàng).

DA_InvestedPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 45 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).
DA_InvestedPlusPlus.desc_vi: Nhận 45 vàng. Khi bắt đầu mỗi vòng đấu, nhận 1 lượt làm mới Cửa Hàng với mỗi 10 vàng vượt hơn 50 (tối đa 80 vàng).

DA_HealingOrbsI.desc_en: When an enemy dies, a nearby ally is healed for 250 Health.

DA_HealingOrbsII.desc_en: When an enemy dies, a nearby ally is healed for 575 Health.

DA_ShoppingSpree.desc_en: When you level up, gain a number of Shop refreshes equal to your level +1. Gain 7 gold.

DA_SwordOverflow.desc_en: Gain 4 BF Swords. Your BF Swords grant +4% Attack Speed.

DA_TradeSector.desc_en: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain 2 gold.

DA_UpwardMobility.desc_en: Buying XP costs 1 less. Gain 2 Health and 2 Shop rerolls whenever you level up.

DA_InvestmentStrategyI.desc_en: Your champions gain 8 permanent max health per interest you earn. Gain 3 gold now.

DA_CaretakersFavor.desc_en: Gain a component anvil when you reach level 5, 6, 7, and 8.

DA_YoungAndWildAndFree.desc_en: You can always move freely on Carousel rounds. Gain 5 gold.

DA_BeltOverflow.desc_en: Gain 4 Giant's Belts. Your Giant's Belts grant +85 bonus Health.

DA_PrismaticTicket.desc_en: Each time your shop is rerolled you have a 45% chance to gain a free reroll.

DA_PatienceIsAVirtue.name_vi: Kiên Nhẫn Là Một Đức Tính
DA_PatienceIsAVirtue.desc_en: Gain 5 rerolls now. Each round, gain 1 free reroll if you did not buy a champion last round.

DA_LivingForge.desc_en: Gain an Artifact Anvil now and after every 10 player combats.

DA_Epoch.desc_en: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain 4 XP and 2 free rerolls.

DA_EpochPlus.desc_en: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain 8 XP and 2 free rerolls.

DA_WandOverflow.desc_en: Gain 4 Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +5% Attack Speed.

DA_Kingslayer.desc_en: After winning player combat, gain 1 gold. If they had more health than you, gain 6 Gold instead. Gain 1 gold.

DA_CookingPot.desc_en: At the start of each round, all allies holding a Frying Pan or Spatula item grant the nearest champion 70 permanent Health. Gain a Frying Pan.

DA_RadiantRelic.desc_en: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

DA_HardBargain.desc_en: You cannot choose your Carousel rewards. Gain an additional 6 player health and 8 gold each carousel round.

DA_Min_Max.desc_en: Gain a Golden Item Remover, 4 random components, and 4 gold.

DA_FocusedFire.desc_en: Your team gains 10% Attack Damage. Every 5 seconds, they gain 4% more.

DA_ExtraBuckles.desc_en: Gain a Giant's Belt. After your champions take 75000 damage, get 2 more.

DA_MakeshiftArmorI.desc_en: Champions without items equipped gain 30 Armor and Magic Resist.

DA_MakeshiftArmorII.desc_en: Champions without items equipped gain 50 Armor and Magic Resist.

DA_CryMeARiver.desc_en: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. Your team gains 1 Mana Regen. After 12 seconds in combat, increase this to 3.

DA_BandOfThievesII.desc_en: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 5 player combats, gain another.

DA_BandOfThievesIIPlus.desc_en: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 5 player combats, gain another.

DA_BandOfThievesIIPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 3 player combats, gain another.

DA_GroupHugI.desc_en: Combat start: Allies grant other adjacent allies 7 Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

DA_GroupHugII.desc_en: Combat start: Allies grant other adjacent allies 10 Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

DA_BacklineBlueprint.desc_en: Gain a 3-cost non-Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

DA_GoldenEgg.desc_en: Gain a golden egg that hatches in 11 rounds for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra round.

DA_TradeSectorPlus.desc_en: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain 8 gold.

DA_BackupBows.desc_en: Gain a Recurve Bow. After your champions attack 1000 times, get 2 more.

DA_CarveAPath.desc_en: Gain a B.F. Sword. After your champions deal 65000 physical damage, gain 2 more.

DA_LuckyGloves.desc_en: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves and 4 gold.

DA_LuckyGlovesPlus.desc_en: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves now, then another after 4 player combats.

DA_MoneyHungry_NotBroken.desc_en: Gain 7 gold now, then 7 gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

DA_MoneyHungryPlus.desc_en: Gain 13 gold now, then 7 gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

DA_MoneyMonsoon.desc_en: Gain 7 gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

DA_Slammin.desc_en: Gain 3 gold. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

DA_SlamminPlus.desc_en: Gain 4 gold and 10 XP now. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

DA_CraftedCrafting.desc_en: Whenever you craft a completed item, gain 2 rerolls.

DA_PandorasItemsI.desc_en:
Round start: items on your bench are randomized.

Gain 1 random component.

DA_PandorasItemsIII.desc_en:
Round start: items on your bench are randomized.

Gain 1 Radiant item.

DA_SalvageBin.desc_en: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 8 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

DA_SalvageBinPlus.desc_en: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 4 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

DA_ClearMind.desc_en: If there are no champions on your bench at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

DA_CelestialBlessingI.desc_en: Your team gains 12% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 200 Health.

DA_CelestialBlessingII.desc_en: Your team gains 18% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 400 Health.

DA_CelestialBlessingIII.desc_en: Your team gains 25% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 1000 Health.

DA_AdvancedLoan.desc_en: Gain 22 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

DA_AdvancedLoanPlus.desc_en: Gain 33 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

DA_Pilfer.desc_en: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time you gain 21 gold worth of champions in this way, gain a Thief's Gloves.

DA_TeamBuilding.desc_en: Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator. Gain another after 5 player combats.

DA_RadiantRascal.desc_en: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

DA_HardCommit.desc_en: Gain a random emblem. Now and at the start of each stage, gain a 1-star champion of that trait with a cost equal to the Stage (max 5) and 3 gold.

DA_LateGameSpecialist.desc_en: When you reach Level 9, gain 27 gold.

DA_ForgeAFriend.desc_en: The next 1-cost champion you buy is 3-star. Gain 5 gold.

DA_HoldTheLine.desc_en: Allies in your back 2 rows gain 11% Ability Power and 11% Attack Damage for each ally that starts combat in your front row.

DA_FindYourCenter.desc_en: Your champion that starts combat in the center of the front row gains 15% Damage Amp and 25% max Health.

DA_LegionOfThrees.desc_en: Gain a random Emblem. Your 3-cost champions and all allies equipped with an Emblem gain 150 Health and 12% Attack Speed.

DA_BirthdayReunion.desc_en: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion. At Level 6, gain a random item component. At Level 9, gain a random 2-star 5-cost champion.

DA_TacticiansKitchen.desc_en: Gain a random Emblem. After 3 rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.

DA_Flexible.desc_en: Gain 1 random Emblem. At the start of every Stage, gain a random Emblem. Your team gains 30 Health for each Emblem they are holding.

DA_EpicRolldown.desc_en: When you reach Level 8, gain 20 Shop rerolls.

DA_LateGameScaling.desc_en: Gain 2 XP at the start of player combat rounds. Your 5-cost champions gain 12% Health and 12% Attack Speed.

DA_SoloPlate.desc_en: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Allies holding Gargoyle Stoneplate gain 17% max Health if they start combat alone in their row.

DA_TwinGuardians.desc_en: If you have exactly 2 allies in your first row, grant them 100 Health, 35 Armor, and 35 Magic Resist.

DA_PromisedProtection.desc_en: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder 20% additional Mana from all sources and 175 max Health.

DA_CommerceCore.desc_en: Gain 16 free Shop rerolls now and 3 every round for the rest of the game.

DA_BodyguardTraining.desc_en: Allies gain 15 Armor and Magic Resist, increased by 2 per player level.

DA_SpeedyDoubleKill.desc_en: Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. When 2 players are eliminated, gain 40 gold.

DA_ForgedInStrength.desc_en: Gain 1 random Artifact. When you drop below 35 Health, gain 1 more random Artifact, 1 random completed item, and 3 random components.

DA_SoulAwakening.desc_en: Combat start: Your team gains 1.5% Attack Damage and Ability Power per second for 10 seconds. At max stacks, deal 12% bonus true damage.

DA_FlowingTears.desc_en: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. After your champions spend 7000 Mana, gain 2 more.

DA_TheGoldenDragon.desc_en: Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up +1 team slot but gain 600 Health and 15% Durability.

DA_ShimmerscaleEssence.desc_en: Gain a Gambler's Blade. After 6 player combats, gain a Mogul's Mail.

DA_SeraphimsStaff.desc_en: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants 2 additional Mana Regen if its holder has 110% or more Ability Power.

DA_ArcaneViktory.desc_en: After 8 seconds of combat, stun the enemy team for 1.5 seconds. Repeat this after 18 seconds of combat.

DA_GiantAndMighty.desc_en: Your team becomes large, gaining 225 Health and 10% max Health.

DA_WovenMagic.desc_en: Gain a random item component. Every 2200 Mana spent by your champions, grants an additional component (max: 0/3).

DA_MaxBuild.desc_en: Gain 10 free Shop rerolls. When you reach level 9, gain 3 free Shop rerolls and a Champion Duplicator.

DA_Hustler.desc_en:
You no longer gain interest but gain 3 gold at the start of every player combat round. Gain 3 gold now.

 10

DA_SliceOfLife.desc_en: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving 1 5-cost champion.

DA_SoloLeveling.desc_en: For the next 5 combats, your team size is 1, but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain 1 XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain 2 item components.

DA_AugmentedPower.desc_en: Your next augment is one tier higher.
DA_AugmentedPower.desc_vi: Nâng Cấp tiếp theo của bạn được tăng một bậc.

DA_Staffsmith.desc_en: Gain 1 random completed item that builds from Needlessly Large Rod now and another in 1 round.

DA_Swordsmith.desc_en: Gain 1 random completed item that builds from B.F. Sword now and another in 1 round.

DA_InfinityProtection.desc_en: Gain 3 gold now. On Stage 3-7, gain an Infinity Force. Infinity Force gives allies in the same row a 12% Health shield.

DA_WeStickTogether.desc_en: Gain an Emblem of a random trait and a completed item anvil. Allies with that trait gain 25% Attack Speed.

DA_ElectrochargeI.desc_en: Every 4 attacks an ally takes, they deal 25-80 (based on current Stage) magic damage to nearby enemies (1 second cooldown).

DA_ElectrochargeII.desc_en: Every 4 attacks an ally takes, they deal 35-120 (based on current Stage) magic damage to nearby enemies (1 second cooldown).

DA_DoubleTrouble.desc_en: When you field exactly 2 copies of a champion, they both gain 25% Attack Damage and Ability Power and 25 Armor, and Magic Resist. When you 3-star, gain a 2-star copy.

DA_CognitiveOverload.desc_en: Gain 7 gold, 1 2-star 1-cost champion, 1 2-cost champion, 2 3-cost champions, 1 XP, and 1 Shop reroll.

DA_Dummify.desc_en: Lose all champions on your board and bench. Gain a Training Dummy with 60% of their combined health. The dummy gains 1150 Health per stage. Gain a random non-tank 2-star 2 cost champion.

DA_EarlyLearnings.desc_en: Your team gains 3% Attack Damage & Ability Power. This increases by 1% after each player combat. 1-cost champions gain double.

DA_KickStart.desc_en: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion and 1 gold.

DA_BaronsLair.desc_en: Gain a random Tank item. After 8 seconds of combat, your team gains 4% bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.

DA_HeartOfSteel.desc_en: Gain a Steadfast Heart. Every 10 seconds of combat its holder survives, Steadfast Heart gains additional 18 permanent max Health.

DA_CursedCrown.desc_en: Gain +2 max team size, but you take double player damage when you lose a player combat.

DA_Corrosion.desc_en: Enemies in the first two rows lose 3 Armor and Magic Resist every 2 seconds.

DA_BoxingLessons.desc_en: Your team gains 30 Health for each ally that starts combat in the front row.

DA_Ascension.desc_en: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 35% Damage Amp.

DA_NoScoutNoPivot.desc_en: Champions that fight in player combat cannot be benched or sold. Your champions gain 1% Health, and 1% Attack Damage and Ability Power after player combat.

DA_GildedSteel.desc_en: Gain two 5-cost champions. If you field at least one 5-cost champion, your 1 to 4-cost champions gain 8% Durability.

DA_Replication.desc_en: Choose 1 of 3 components. For the next 2 rounds, gain a copy of that component.

DA_SweetTreats.desc_en: Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains 16 Health for each item equipped on champions.

DA_ComponentBuffet.desc_en: Whenever you would get a component, gain a component anvil instead. Gain a random component. The anvil offers 4 choices.

DA_MagicRoll.desc_en: Roll 3 dice. Gain rewards based on their total.
DA_MagicRoll.desc_vi:
Đổ 3 xúc xắc. Nhận nhiều loại phần thưởng dựa trên tổng số đã đổ được.

{Augment.Variant.MagicRoll.Reward}

DA_SlightlyMagicRoll.desc_en: Roll a die. Gain rewards based on the number rolled.

DA_FrontlineFoundation.desc_en: Gain a 2-star 1-cost Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

DA_SpiritOfRedemption.desc_en: Gain a Spirit Visage. Every 5 seconds, Spirit Visage heals allies within 1 hex for 9% of their missing Health.

DA_TheTower.desc_en: Gain a giant Training Dummy. Every 4 seconds, it zaps the 3 nearest enemies dealing 5% max Health true damage.

DA_ExclusiveCustomization.desc_en: Gain a Lucky Item Chest, a Magnetic Remover and 7 gold.

DA_Warpath.desc_en: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing 80 player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items.

DA_DeadlierBlades.desc_en: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain 1% Attack Damage whenever their holders score a takedown.

DA_FeelingLucky.desc_en: Gain 12 gold, then flip a coin. If heads, gain 4 more gold.

DA_ComebackStory.desc_en: Your team gains 4 Health and 0.4% Attack Speed per missing player Health.

DA_CallToChaos.desc_en: Gain a powerful and random reward.

DA_LuxurySubscription.desc_en:
Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and 5 gold.

At the start of the next 2 stages, gain the package again.

DA_ComponentQuest.desc_en: Gain a random component and 1 gold. The next 7 times you win a player combat, gain a different random component. Afterwards, gain 1 gold.

DA_NestingAnvils.desc_en: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 6 gold.

DA_NestingAnvilsPlus.desc_en: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 8 gold.

DA_ChampDelivery.desc_en: Gain 3 2-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

DA_ChampDeliveryPlus.desc_en: Gain 3 3-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

DA_ChampDeliveryPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 3 4-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

DA_VerticalityI.desc_en: Champions gain 1.5% Attack Damage, 1.5% Ability Power, 1.5 Armor, and 1.5 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_VerticalityII.desc_en: Champions gain 2.5% Attack Damage, 2.5% Ability Power, 2 Armor, and 2 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_VerticalityIII.desc_en: Champions gain 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 3.5 Armor, and 3.5 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

DA_CapitalGainsI.desc_en: Store gold equal to the interest you earn. On 3-3, gain gold equal to 100% of the stored gold. Gain 1 gold now.

DA_CapitalGainsII.desc_en: Store gold equal to the interest you earn. On 3-3, gain gold equal to 125% of the stored gold. Gain 3 gold now.

DA_FutureFocused.desc_en: Your Tactician loses 20 Health, but after 5 player combats, gain 3 4-cost champions and 5 gold.

DA_QuickStreaks.desc_en: You gain twice as much progress towards win and loss streaks. Gain 2 gold.

DA_ClutteredMind.desc_en: Gain 4 1-cost champions now. If your bench is full at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

DA_BirthdayPresent.desc_en: Gain a 2-star champion and 1 gold each time you level up. The champion's cost tier is your level minus 4 (max: 5-cost).

DA_GoldenGamble.desc_en: Gain 2 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

DA_GoldenGamblePlus.desc_en: Gain 3 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

DA_GoldenGamblePlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 6 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

DA_UrfsGrabBag.desc_en: Gain 1 Spatula, 3 random components, and 5 gold.

DA_URF.desc_en: Gain a Spatula. Spatula or Frying Pan items gain 20% Attack Speed and 3 Mana Regen.

DA_PartialAscension.desc_en: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 20% Damage Amp.

DA_Expedition.desc_en: At the start of every round, lose the champion in the rightmost bench slot. After losing 33 gold of champions in this way, gain a powerful reward. Gain a 3-cost champion now.

DA_TonsOfStatsI.desc_en: Your team gains 44 Health, 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 4 Armor, 4 Magic Resist, 4% Attack Speed, and 4 Mana.

DA_TonsOfStatsII.desc_en: Your team gains 88 Health, 8% Attack Damage, 8% Ability Power, 8 Armor, 8 Magic Resist, 8% Attack Speed, and 8 Mana.

DA_BoosterPack.desc_en: Gain 12 gold of random champions. (At least one 3-cost guaranteed!)

DA_BoosterPackPlus.desc_en: Gain 18 gold of random champions. (At least one 4-cost guaranteed!)

DA_BoosterPackPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain 26 gold of random champions. (At least one 5-cost guaranteed!)

DA_CyberneticUplink_Gold.desc_en: Your champions holding an item gain 100 Health and 2 Mana Regen. Gain a Tear of the Goddess.

DA_CyberneticImplants_Gold.desc_en: Your champions holding an item gain 100 Health and 15% Attack Damage. Gain a B.F. Sword.

DA_PlotArmor.desc_en: Your team gains 10 Armor and Magic Resist. After falling below 50% Health, increase this to 40 for the rest of combat.

DA_ItsMeBaby.desc_en: Gain a championship hex in the bottom right corner. The champion in it gains 15% Damage Amp and 15% Attack Speed, and drops 1 gold every 5 takedowns.

DA_DeadlierCaps.desc_en: Gain a Rabadon's Deathcap. Rabadon's Deathcaps grant 1 Mana Regen and permanently gain 1% Ability Power whenever their holders score a takedown.

DA_GoldDestiny.desc_en: Gain a random Gold Augment and 3 gold.

DA_GoldDestinyPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Gold Augment and 5 gold.

DA_SilverDestiny.desc_en: Gain a random Silver Augment and 2 gold.

DA_SilverDestinyPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Silver Augment and 4 gold.

DA_SilverDestinyPlusPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Silver Augment and 7 gold.

DA_PrismaticDestiny.desc_en: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 2 gold.

DA_PrismaticDestinyPlus.desc_en: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 7 gold.

DA_MissedConnections.desc_en: Gain a copy of each 1-cost champion.

DA_ConstructACompanion.desc_en: The next 1-cost champion you buy is 3-star. Gain 2 gold.

DA_SpreadingRoots.desc_en: Gain a random Emblems. After 3 combats, gain another.

DA_TheTraitTreePlus.desc_en: Gain 3 random Emblems, a Reforger, and 4 gold.

DA_TimeSkip.desc_en: Disable your Shop for the next 3 rounds. Then gain 32 XP.

DA_TraitLadder.desc_en: Gain a random emblem. After fielding 2 non-unique traits in a player combat, gain a reward. Then increase the number of traits needed and the size of the reward.

DA_PandorasBench.desc_en: At the start of every round, champions on the 3 rightmost bench slots transform into random champions of the same cost. Gain 1 gold.

DA_Recombobulator.desc_en: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Gain 2 Magnetic Removers and 3 free rerolls.

DA_18_WeightTheWorth.desc_en: The first time you 3-star a champion, gain a copy of them each round for the rest of the game. 3-starring the same champion again grants additional copies. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator.

DA_BuildABud.desc_en: Gain a random 3-star 1-cost champion. Gain 9 gold.

DA_18_FOURcing.desc_en: Gain a random 4-cost champion. For each item equipped to that champion, your team gains 100 health.

DA_BonusGiftPlus.desc_en: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a 25% chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain 2 gray loot orbs.

DA_BonusGift.desc_en: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a 25% chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain 1 gray loot orbs.

DA_Arcanist19.desc_en: Your team gains Ability Power, Arcanists gain more.
DA_Arcanist19.desc_vi: Đội của bạn nhận Sức Mạnh Phép Thuật, tướng Pháp Sư nhận nhiều hơn.

DA_Renegade19.desc_en: Renegades gain Precision, Critical Strike Chance, and Critical Strike Damage.
DA_Renegade19.desc_vi: Tướng Ngoại Đạo được tăng Chuẩn Xác, Tỉ Lệ Chí Mạng và Sát Thương Chí Mạng.

DA_Hitmaker19.desc_en: Hitmakers gain 12% Attack Damage. The Hitmakers with the most items become Big Shots, gaining even more Attack Damage.

DA_Bodyguard19.desc_en: While at least one Bodyguard is alive, your team gains 15 Armor and Magic Resist. Bodyguards gain more.

DA_Frontman19.desc_en: Your team gains 100 Health. Frontmen gain more, which increases after the first time they cast.

DA_Choreographer19.desc_en: Allies who start in the front 2 rows gain Shield. All other allies gain Damage Amp. Choreographers gain double.
DA_Choreographer19.desc_vi: Đồng minh bắt đầu ở 2 hàng trước sẽ nhận Lá Chắn. Tất cả các đồng minh khác sẽ nhận Khuếch Đại Sát Thương. Biên Đạo nhận gấp đôi.

DA_Encore19.desc_en: When Encore champions fire projectiles with their abilities, they fire an extra one with reduced effectiveness.
DA_Encore19.desc_vi: Khi các tướng Encore bắn ra đường đạn bằng kỹ năng của mình, họ bắn thêm một đường đạn với hiệu quả giảm đi.

DA_Juggernaut19.desc_en: Juggernauts gain Durability, increasing based on their missing Health.

Hyperpop champions gain Health and Attack Speed. After player combat, they generate /// Hype based on their star level +  Hype per takedown.

DA_Heavenscale19.desc_vi: Các tướng Cổ Phong nhận thêm chỉ số, tăng theo cấp độ người chơi của bạn.
effects: (4) Choose between two Scrolls that can be equipped by Gu Feng champions. One of the Scrolls opens a dangerous path to Level 11.

DA_Illbeats19.desc_en: Open the Illbeats Mixer to allocate Decibels. Illbeats champions receive different stats based on your mix. Your team gains 50% of the mix.

DA_IonicSpark19.desc_en: Fans cheer on Ionic Spark members with gifts every 4 seconds. Ionic Spark members gain Health.

DA_KDA19.desc_en: K/DA champions release new songs based on their total star level. At Combat Start and after 8 seconds, they gain power for each of their songs.
effects: (5) DRUM GO DUM: 12% Shield for 8 seconds.
(10) I'LL SHOW YOU: Boost all previous effects by 1.25.
(13) WATCH ME: Stun all enemies for 1.25 seconds.
(15) FIRESTARTER: Enemies take 16% max Health magic damage over 8 seconds.

DA_Manager19.desc_en: Gain a Spotlight Hex. The ally who starts combat in it gains bonuses at Combat Start and every 5 seconds.

DA_Mosher19.desc_en: Slayers gain Attack Speed and Omnivamp, which increases up to 100%, based on their missing Health.

DA_OceanSong19.desc_en:
Gain placeable instruments that empower adjacent allies. Empowered allies regenerate 2% Health every 3 seconds.

Empowered Beach Pop champions gain Attack Speed and also regenerate Mana every 3 seconds.

DA_Pentakill19.desc_en:
Pentakill members gain Attack Damage and Ability Power. 

The first few enemies to drop below 10% Health are executed and summon an allied ghoul in their place.
effects: (7) 35% , 4 enemies. The first enemy to die summons the Iron Maiden instead.

DA_Prodigy19.desc_en: Your team gains 1 Mana Regen. Prodigies gain more.
effects: (5) 7; The lowest Health ally heals for 12% of damage dealt by Prodigies' abilties.

DA_Swiftstriker19.desc_en:
Your team gains 10% Attack Speed. 

Swiftstrikers gain more every 2 seconds, up to 5 times.

DA_Trickshot19.desc_en: Trickshots' Attacks and Abilities ricochet. Each ricochet deals a percentage of the previous bounce's damage.
DA_Trickshot19.desc_vi: Đòn Đánh và Kỹ Năng của tướng Xạ Thuật Sư có thể nảy bật. Mỗi lần nảy sẽ gây một phần sát thương của lần nảy bật trước đó.

DA_Jazz19.desc_en: For each active trait (except uniques), your team gains bonus Health and Damage Amp.
DA_Jazz19.desc_vi: Với mỗi tộc/hệ đang kích hoạt (trừ những tộc/hệ độc nhất), đội của bạn nhận thêm Máu và Khuếch Đại Sát Thương.

DA_TwistedFate19_UniqueTrait.desc_en: Twisted Fate marks the nearest ally as his Tango Partner. They ignite with passion, gaining 15% Attack Speed. Their damage 1% Burns and 33% Wounds enemies for 3 seconds.

DA_Garen19_UniqueTrait.desc_en: At 35% Health, gain Shield for 6 seconds equal to 50% of Healing and Shielding received this combat.

DA_Amumu19_UniqueTrait.desc_en: Amumu gains 25/40/55 Armor and Magic Resist if he starts combat with no adjacent allies.

DA_Nunu19_UniqueTrait.desc_en:
Your team heals for 1% max Health per second. 

Enter Disco Fever after casting 6 times, granting your team 125% Attack Speed.

DA_Gwen19_UniqueTrait.desc_en: For the first 12 seconds of combat, your strongest Gwen is surrounded by Mist and cannot be targeted by attacks. Allies gain 10% Durability while within the Mist.

DA_Rell19_UniqueTrait.desc_en:
At 50% max Health, Rell mounts up and fully heals over 2 seconds.

While mounted, her max Mana is reduced by 40 and every 3rd attack deals 0/0/500% of her total Armor and Magic Resist as magic damage in a line.

DA_Zeri19_UniqueTrait.desc_en: The first time your strongest Zeri damages an enemy each combat, vampiric bats steal 8% Attack Damage from them, bringing it back to her.

DA_DrMundo19_UniqueTrait.desc_en:
Gain a Record Contract now and every 4 rounds. Contracted champions gain 5% Damage Amp and their kills grant Dr. Mundo 25 permanent Health. 

Total Health: 0

Combat Start: If your strongest Alistar has over 500 bonus Health, he gains 15% Durability.

Current: 0 Bonus

DA_Seraphine19_IndieTrait.desc_en:
After combat, Seraphine attracts new followers, granting you a random champion. 
 
When you 3-star a champion, she becomes a Rising Star, upgrading her Ability and granting you a special subscriber reward. 

After 3-starring 4 champions, she becomes a Superstar!

DA_Seraphine19_RisingStarTrait.desc_en:
After combat, Seraphine attracts new followers, granting you a random champion. 
 
When you 3-star a champion, she becomes a Rising Star, upgrading her Ability and granting you a special subscriber reward. 

After 3-starring 4 champions, she becomes a Superstar!

DA_Seraphine19_SuperstarTrait.desc_en:
After combat, Seraphine attracts new followers, granting you a random champion. 
 
When you 3-star a champion, she becomes a Rising Star, upgrading her Ability and granting you a special subscriber reward. 

After 3-starring 4 champions, she becomes a Superstar!

DA_Malzahar19_UniqueTrait.desc_en:
Mystical Instruments can appear in your shop. There is one of each rarity. 

For each one you have, your team gains 3% Ability Power. Malzahar gains double.

If he has dealt 60000 damage and you have all 5 instruments, Malzahar writes his masterpiece, unlocking Baron Nashor.

DA_Sona19_UniqueTrait.desc_en:
When Sona is fielded, choose a band to feature, gaining their trait.

Sona converts all bonus Attack Damage and Attack Speed into Ability Power.

DA_Collab19.desc_en:
Collab champions become inspired after taking or dealing damage  times, gaining Attack Damage and Ability Power.

Every  inspirations during player combat, gain copies of Collab champions. (0/)

DA_Janna19_UniqueTrait.desc_en: Combat Start: Your strongest Janna releases a tornado that travels forward, knocking up enemies in its path for 1.25/1.75/99 seconds.

DA_Nidalee19_UniqueTrait.desc_en:
When Nidalee casts her Ability while above 75% Health, she transforms into Cougar Form and casts Pounce Party. Otherwise, she casts Dance of Life. 

Whenever she drops below 50% Health, she leaps away and transforms back to Human form.

DA_BaronNashor19_UniqueTrait.desc_en:
Baron Nashor takes up 2 team slots and is unstoppable. 

After the first time Baron Nashor casts, he envelops the board in song, stealing 5% Attack Damage, Ability Power, Attack Speed, and Critical Strike Chance from all enemies.

DA_Akali_TrueDamage19_UniqueTrait.desc_en: Akali gains a different passive on each side of the True Damage record. A-Side prints gold. B-Side restores Player Health.
DA_Akali_TrueDamage19_UniqueTrait.desc_vi: Akali nhận một nội tại khác nhau ở mỗi mặt của đĩa nhạc True Damage. Mặt A sinh vàng. Mặt B hồi Máu Người Chơi.

DA_MysticInstrument19.desc_en:
Collect all five Mystical instruments to write Malzahar’s masterpiece and unlock Baron Nashor! 

Cannot be fielded in combat.

DA_Rakan19_UniqueTrait.desc_en: Rakan is accompanied by 2/2/9 placeable clones that have 50% of his max Health, deal 30% damage, and copy his Completed and Radiant items.
